item.title: ‘Tell us’: Gaza family trapped between hope and pain over missing brothers
item.description: The disappearance of two boys last year has turned the Abdel Aal family’s life into an endless search for answers.

item.title: Grid failure plunges Cuba into nationwide blackout
item.description: Cuba’s ageing power grid collapsed on Sunday after a weekend of outages and amid US-imposed fuel shortages.

item.title: Fires in Spokane, Washington, burn 600 structures, force 60,000 evacuations
item.description: A total of 1,000sq km (386sq miles) has burned across Washington state, and some of the fires have not been contained.

item.title: Trump pauses ‘massive attack’ on Iran, says new talks to begin
item.description: US President Trump says new talks with Iran will start Monday ‘in the form of a negotiation’ after calling off attack.

item.title: Brazil’s Lula launches reelection bid amid foreign interference concerns
item.description: Brazil's President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has officially launched his reelection campaign.

item.title: The battle for the Maasai Mara: Can Kenya’s most iconic ecosystem be saved?
item.description: Court cases over new lodges have raised questions about protecting one of Africa’s greatest wildlife spectacles.

item.title: Japan and US confirm rare joint intervention to prop up yen
item.description: US President Donald Trump says helping to bolster the Japanese currency is a sign of friendship.

item.title: Suicide bombing kills at least 14 people in Pakistan’s Swat Valley
item.description: Footage shows blast victims hurried into a hospital in northwestern Pakistan, after a suicide bombing.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says talks to resume; Tehran urges US to honour MoU
item.description: US President Donald Trump says an agreement with Iran is imminent, with negotiations set to begin on Monday.

item.title: Trump says new round of Iran talks will begin Monday
item.description: The US president says Gulf allies and Tehran urged him to delay planned strikes, as oil prices dropped in response.

item.title: Brazil’s Lula launches fourth-term bid, focuses on national sovereignty
item.description: Lula seeks to use Bolsonaro family ties with Trump to cast election as fight against submission to foreign interests.

item.title: Sudan army drone attack on Darfur kills 35, rights group says
item.description: Tens of thousands of people have been killed in the ongoing war between army chief al-Burhan and RSF commander Dagalo.

item.title: Wildfires force mass evacuations across the Pacific Northwest
item.description: Fast-moving wildfires are forcing evacuations across Washington State, US and nearby British Columbia, Canada.

item.title: Local volunteers help rebuild destroyed Christian monastery in Lebanon
item.description: Interfaith volunteers rebuild war-damaged Catholic monastery in Lebanon’s Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh.

item.title: UK PM Burnham vows to be ‘relentless’ on Channel migrant crossings
item.description: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said his government will be "relentless" in tackling small boat crossings the Channel.

item.title: Venezuela and the Dominican Republic say they will work to restore ties
item.description: Both countries have agreed on a plan to restore diplomatic relations cut off after a contested vote in 2024.

item.title: Is Washington dictating the agenda for talks in Venezuela?
item.description: Venezuela's government and a section of the opposition plan to hold talks, backed by the US.

item.title: How much has AIPAC spent against Michigan’s Abdul El-Sayed? And why?
item.description: Pro-Israel group unleashes its spending power to help elect Haley Stevens to US Senate against progressive doctor.

item.title: Israelis attack Armenian monastery in Jerusalem’s Old City
item.description: Six Jewish Israelis were filmed spitting at the entrance to Saint James Monastery in Jerusalem's Old City.

item.title: Body of climber Nirmal Purja, six others recovered after Pakistan avalanche
item.description: Search for remains of three last climbers continues on Broad Peak, days after avalanche killed all 10 mountaineers.

item.title: Most Americans say Trump has gone too far on US immigration: Poll
item.description: Half of Americans say Trump has gone too far on deportations, though most Republicans still support his approach.

item.title: Iran says negotiations with Oman over Strait of Hormuz in final stages
item.description: Tehran's announcement comes after Trump said US would hold off on new Iran attack in hope of quick deal.

item.title: Two helicopters collide mid-air while tackling wildfires in Greece
item.description: Footage has emerged showing the moment two firefighting helicopters collided mid-air while fighting wildfires in Greece.

item.title: Russian and Ukrainian strikes kill 14 on both sides
item.description: Ukrainian strikes target Russian oil hubs and high-rises as Zelenskyy warns of critical Patriot interceptor shortages

item.title: ‘Iron fist’ doesn’t work with Iran: Former US hostage in Tehran
item.description: Former US hostage John Limbert says Washington ‘can’t bomb and assassinate its way to a better relationship’ with Iran.
